n: κυριόυ (kuriou) 'Lord' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
πᾶσαν (pasan) 'all' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἅπασαν (hapasan) '[his] perfect' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
σοφῷ (sophō) 'wise' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἐν Χριστῷ, (en Christō) 'in Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
διαλογισμῶν (dialogismōn) 'dissensions' occurs in a few manuscripts (WH) instead of διαλογισμοῦ· (dialogismou) 'dissension;' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg+TR+Byz)
μὴ αἰσχροκερδῆ, (mē aischrokerdē) 'not greedy of base gain' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
θεὸς (theos) 'God' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ὃς (hos) 'Who' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ὀνειδιζόμεθα (oneidizometha) 'are reviled' occurs in traditional manuscripts (SBL+TR+Byz) instead of ἀγωνιζόμεθα, (agōnizometha) 'strive,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+WH+Treg)
ἐν πνεύματι, (en pneumati) 'in spirit' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καλὸν καὶ (kalon kai) 'good and' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
πιστὸς ἢ (pistos ē) 'faithful or' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
κυρίου (kuriou) 'Lord' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
σου (sou) 'of you' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Ἀφίστασο ἀπὸ τῶν τοιούτων.¶ (Aphistaso apo tōn toioutōn) 'do depart from [one of] such.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
δῆλον (dēlon) 'evident' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
πρᾳότητα (praotēta) '[and] humility' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of πραϋπαθίαν· (praupathian) '[and] gentleness;' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
τῷ ζῶντι (tō zōnti) 'who is living' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
αἰωνιόυ (aiōniou) '[is] eternal' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ὄντως (ontōs) '[is] truly' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)

ἀμήν. πρός Τιμόθεον πρώτη ἐγράφη ἀπό Λαοδικείας ἥτις ἐστίν μητρόπολις φρυγίας τῆς Πακατιανῆς.¶ (amēn pros Timotheon prōtē egraphē apo Laodikeias hētis estin mētropolis phrugias tēs Pakatianēs) 'Amen. to Timothy first it was written from Laodicea which is capital of Phrygia of Pacatiana.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
